status: preregistered design; not implemented or deployed
scope: Cost-quality audit only; does not alter entry, add, exit, leverage, bankroll or eligibility rules
effective: Future collector observations after implementation/deployment are verified; no retrospective use of current context snapshots

collection.markets: Active canonical Genius paper positions explicitly on first Hyperliquid perp dex; unknown/unsupported venues excluded with reason
validation: Universe/context arrays must align in length
Market association must use universe index, not an independently sorted array
Oracle/mark must be finite positive; funding must be finite
Invalid/absent context recorded as missing; no zero replacement
collection.failurePolicy: Record bounded error and retry only at next scheduled collection opportunity; no paid access or credentials

frozenEstimator.name: preceding-oracle-30s
frozenEstimator.oracleSelection: Most recent complete response received at or before h, h minus responseReceivedAt <=30 seconds, request duration <=5 seconds; never select a post-boundary oracle
frozenEstimator.rate: Actual fundingHistory row timestamped h once published; current context funding is predicted and never substituted
frozenEstimator.quantity: Canonical paper quantity and direction reconstructed from saved fills effective at h; fills whose request/observation uncertainty straddles h are flagged ambiguous and excluded
frozenEstimator.calculation: Modeled USDC funding = -signedPaperQuantityAtH * precedingOraclePx * realizedHourlyFundingRate; long signed positive, short negative
labels: modeled approximation, not exact settlement funding
sample age and request interval uncertainty displayed
frozenEstimator.missingPolicy: Any missing oracle/rate/quantity or timing gate failure yields missing receipt; never zero, interpolation, carry-forward beyond30s or retrospective quote
frozenEstimator.ledgerPolicy: Separate cost-audit records only; no cash/P&L overwrite or claim fundingComplete

validationBeforeDeployment: Synthetic boundary cases: pre/post h,30s threshold,5s duration, missing/nonfinite data, reordered universe and changed leg quantity
Prove no trade/accounting writes in capture path
First published raw context receipt plus measured cadence/gaps/errors
One prospective hourly estimate checked against saved oracle/rate/quantity inputs; keep exactFunding=false
nonGoals: No new trading strategy or optimization variants
No proof of source wallet identity, collateral or liquidation survival
nextAction: Implement a failure-isolated read-only collector path and tests, then verify actual publication before claiming collection exists
